To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
astrocytes protect neurons from death caused by reactive oxygen and reactive nitrogen species.
astrocytes protect neurons against reactive oxygen and nitrogen radical‐induced damage.
astrocytes protect neurons against RO/N‐induced damage.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the effects of astrocytes on the survival of neurons in the presence of free radicals, and the mechanisms by which they exert their protective effects.
the effects of the astrocytic extracellular matrix (ECM) on neurons.
the role of astrocytes in neuroprotection against reactive oxygen and nitrogen (RO/NS).
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
astrocyte‐conditioning medium and astrocyte‐produced extracellular matrix (astrocyte‐ECM) protect neurons from ROS‐mediated damage.
the astrocyte has an essential role in the maintenance of the neuronal network, and the astrocyte is a key player in the development and maintenance of the brain.

the astrocytic neuroprotective effects are mediated via a combination of soluble and matrix‐derived factors, and these factors may be involved in astrocytic neurotrophic and neuroprotective functions in vivo.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
astrocytes have a neuroprotective effect on neurons against reactive oxygen and nitrogen (RO/NS).
astrocytes protect neurons from reactive oxygen and reactive nitrogen species‐induced damage through the secretion of both soluble and insoluble protective factors.

astrocytes have neuroprotective effects on neurons against RO/ NS‐induced damage through the secretion of soluble factors and the production of extracellular matrix components, such as fibronectin or laminin.
The main takeaway from our work is that
astrocytes are neuroprotective against a number of insults, but that the mechanism is not well understood.
astrocytes have the ability to secrete a variety of factors that can help protect neurons from oxidative damage.
the astrocyte-derived matrix (AsECMs) protects neurons from ROS and reactive nitrogen species (RNS) damage.
